workingTitle: THE MEMORY BETWEEN — A WALRUS FILM
storySpine: Public second chapter to the original The Space Between. Recovered production memory connects making this Walrus film to Walrus itself. Geometry is fresh conceptual art; parent overlays and verified memory proof carry factual claims.
visualDisclosure: All mechanisms are conceptual illustrations, not literal protocol schematics or implementation claims.
